purpose: Keep an actual private JSphGpuSingle::Run and original native BI4 trajectory separate from a read-only, all-saved-endpoint force audit. No production callback/virtual hook or formal XML changes.

immutable_include.reuse: Rename its main once to reuse typed NativeArray/Order/Error/Fresh and one AppInfo. Its no-wall NativeSet/reader/solver are not called. No nested Darcy/perm or component source inclusion.

additional_link_dependency: Windows system bcrypt.lib via #pragma comment(lib). Root plans a new helper_r2 builder that explicitly appends the exact WindowsSDK bcrypt.lib absolute path and unique library hash to the link receipt; existing helper_r1 remains immutable. The one helper plus110 authoritative production objects closure is unchanged. BCrypt SHA256 only; hash-object buffer outlives BCryptDestroyHash. No custom crypto implementation, external hash process or third-party library.

cli.solver: upl_gpu_wall_actual_r1.exe --solver MODEL WINDOW -gpu:0 -stable -mdbc_freeslip INPUT_PREFIX NEW_OUTPUT -dirdataout data -svres
cli.reader: upl_gpu_wall_actual_r1.exe --read MODEL CPU|GPU WINDOW DATA_DIR DT RUNTIME_XML NEW_REVIEW_DIR

cli.MODEL: Exactly k0|constant|variable. k0 and constant use private conductivity flag false/Ck0; variable uses true/Ck2^-13. GPU XML public master remains false and model0/Ck0, explicitly distinct from private fixture flags.
cli.WINDOW: Exactly smoke|full|k0-short. No arbitrary runtime/dt/end override. Each executable invocation is one owned job; no automatic stage runner.
cli.mdbc_warning: Plain -mdbc overrides XML FreeSlip to velocity mode0 and is not equivalent to -mdbc_freeslip. Actual class Init and Finish reject it; do not retry completed programs for offline-check issues.

endpoint_force_audit.independent_object: One separate object initializes actual GPU wall ConfigDomain/InitRunGpu exactly once from the bound seed. For each completed nativePART, directly read all1280 native values, assign only the independent audit object's state, and do not call JPartsLoad4/PartBegin or a physical integrator. This is an explicit frozen-state import, not production Run/restart.
endpoint_force_audit.cell_periodic_lifecycle: By actual native ID map build contiguous1280 normal-native host positions/codes, call actual LoadDcellParticles only on those normal entries, scatter native state/Dcell into existing normal slots, then actual RunCellDivide(true) retires old periodic images and creates/sorts fresh real fluid+wall replicas. Never pass stale periodic images to LoadDcell, manually rewrite Np, or silently skip excluded particles. Require1024soil/256fixed owners,nonzero wall/fluid periodic witnesses and zero actual exclusions each frame.
endpoint_force_audit.stage: Production Run orders ComputeStep->RunCellDivide->TimeStep/LastDt->SaveData->Nstep++. SaveData again callsFS before native compaction. Source last-stage theta is the integrator's corrector-stage diagnostic, not endpoint theta. Audit invokes one actual Interaction_Forces(SymPredictor) at each imported endpoint, then original independent physical-plane/force/rate checks and PosInteraction. The source saved theta and newly computed endpoint theta are separate CSV columns.
endpoint_force_audit.clock: Audit TimeStep/Nstep are assigned the exact native source metadata solely to label the frozen-state call. LastDt is declared bookkeeping(dt afterinitial0),not a field recovered from BI4. Record source signed dterror separately from unchanged audit-local FixedDt error. No ComputeStep/Run, physical clock advance, or predictor histories.
endpoint_force_audit.ownership_and_rollback: Before diagnostic rollback, require actual force and cell rebuild to preserve source soil positions,v,p,p0,J,double stress,plastic,passive density and zero load bitwise by ID. Recomputed theta/FSType/FSNormal are diagnostics, intentionally not claimed identical to saved fields. Restore only these saved diagnostic fields in the independent audit object after recording endpoint values, then require all33 saved soil columns byte-exact. Fixed reconstructed state is a closure result,not claimed immutable wall material. Original files are never written.

No subsampling or automatic omission after a failure. Source PART SHA before/after each call and final recheck of every earlier source PART; runtime SHA unchanged.
endpoint_force_audit.force_reaction: Original Σsoil rho_t Vi Ace plus independently reconstructed wall pair reaction. Actual float stress/position-gradient pair arithmetic, V0J quadrature. Norm residual<=128FLT_EPS sum|pairforces|+4096DBL_EPS max(1,sum|pairforces|),unchanged. This is a bounded budget,not an exact global conservation proof.

endpoint_force_audit.original_face_bounds: bv=4epsF vmax sum|beta|+4096epsD condition vmax+1e-4 A; bq=k0/gamma[2epsF pmax sum|alpha|+4rhow epsF amax sum|beta|+4096epsD condition(gscale+rhow amax)]+1e-4 Qstar. Require|vn|<=bv<.01A and both|q0|,|qphysical|<=bq<.01Qstar at every positive-k sample; k0 flux exactly0. The1e-4 characteristic terms remain explicit truncation budgets,not pure roundoff.
endpoint_force_audit.negative_controls: Record wrong zero-wallAce and wrong unreflected/copy-wallAce physical-face q at every sample. Positive-k full window requires each counterfactual to violate originalbq on at least one postinitial face for both reference-k and physical-k. Do not require nonempty controls at t0 or in k0 and do not tune the field for them.

Each native rate compared under original64FLT_EPS all-absolute-raw-term budget+256DBL_EPS max(1,|Btheta|)+1e-6Pa/s. Actual source kernel is called by realInteraction_Forces,not substituted. At least one wall and one periodic-wall receiver every frame. Conditional actualC is not an independent proof of constructingC.
endpoint_force_audit.gradient_and_time: Read real stage cache after actual force,independently calculate endpoint uk from actualC/J and compare within64FLT_EPS max(1,reference). Call actual necessary acoustic/diffusion-scale helper after true force stats exist and enforce current dt and gradient necessary bound. Never call DtVariable merely to fabricate source dterror.
